title: Yaka
tagline: Yaka is a tool to automatically distribute stablecoins' yield from Aave to several strategies to newcomers who wants to start investing in cryptocurencies for long term, such a Dollar Cost Average strategies in Index Tokens or even payments.
description:
This project combines automated yield aggregator with DCA (Dollar Cost Average) strategy, where users can gain interest from Aave in their stablecoins and those interests are invested weekly in several strategies in several indexes like PieDAO, DPI and/or NFTx.
We are building an Interest-as-a-Service platform where users can compound, reinvesting or pay their subscription services directly from the yield generated, we call it No-Loss Investing.
how_its_made:
This project uses Metamask behind the scenes to connect to Aave. We used OpenZeppelin, DAI, Aave v2, React, Solidity, truffle, and hardhat.



hacky: using the docker-compose of aave v2 to create the mainnet fork does not work following the github readme



We think that our project has potential but technically is still in a very early stage
